name: Command: Modern Operations / Command PE
description: Highly detailed modern naval and air warfare simulation covering platforms from WWII to near-future scenarios. Models sensor, weapon, and platform interactions at the unit level to produce emergent operational outcomes. The Professional Edition (Command PE) is used by naval war colleges, defense think tanks, and government analysts; the commercial version is available on Steam.
general_score_metric: scenario outcome / mission success rate (scenario-specific score)
reputation: widely regarded as the most detailed unclassified naval and air warfare simulation; used by naval war colleges, RAND, CNA, and multiple defense ministries
notes: Extensive database of real-world platforms, sensors, and weapons. Scenario editor supports custom scenario design. Command PE adds classification-appropriate data layers and institutional licensing. Commercial version available on Steam at ~$39.99.
